community.location: Pocket 2, Mayur Vihar / Saket, Delhi (BRPL Circle)

logs.details: Algorithm rebalanced credit allocation to 100.0% zero-shortfall across 14 units with ₹1,120/mo avg net benefit.
Distribution transformer capacity clearance issued (58% saturation, 22 kW spare headroom on DT-14B).
Transferred ₹45,000 CAPEX share into Axis Bank RWA Escrow account for 2.4 kW allocation.
All 3 prerequisite safety conditions verified for Block C Virtual Net Metering filing.

result.provenance: Property: SYNTHETIC; 2026-10 billing: SYNTHETIC; submeter sources shown per shop; generation: saved yield and monthly self-use assumption; costs/tariff/sharing: operator scenario inputs
assumptions: Monthly load model: no interval load profile is stored. Self-use is generation × saved self-use ratio, capped by site consumption.
Annual projection repeats this selected month 12 times; 25-year flat real cash flows, no escalation, degradation, replacement or financing.
Fixed and demand charges remain unchanged. Taxes/surcharges are zero because no validated tax schedule is stored.
Export rate defaults to zero. Any nonzero rate is an operator assumption, capped at remaining bill charges; eligibility is unverified.
Tenant pool shares positive net operating benefit after costs, capped by participating tenants’ energy charges. Missing period readings receive no allocation.
Policy v1, consumption weighted, largest-remainder paise. Scenario sharing overrides the saved percentage without editing the agreement.
Internal benefit projections only, not official VNM credits. NPV/IRR are illustrative unlevered investor estimates using the stated forecast.
Energy is valued only at the property's saved import tariff of ₹9/kWh.
The engine sums hourly min(site load, expected generation) minus min(site load, actual generation), rounded to paise, from the authorised backend analysis.
This is an avoided-energy-charge estimate, not an audited utility-bill loss. Fixed charges, demand charges, taxes, export settlement, tenant benefits and financing are excluded.
Only scored, complete daylight intervals contribute. Above-baseline days contribute zero shortfall rather than a negative loss.

priorityReasons: A safety-related inverter warning is present, so safety escalation takes precedence over financial thresholds.
observed: Generation was 40.6% of the weather-adjusted expectation over 3 scored days (2,826.62 kWh expected vs 1,147.42 kWh actual).
Weather context across the period: 3 sunny. The baseline already adjusts for modelled irradiation, cloud, rain and temperature.
The estimated avoided-energy-charge shortfall is ₹8,654.6 at ₹9/kWh, before demand charges, fixed charges and export settlement.
possible: Panel soiling, new shading or a partial string disconnection may reduce production; none is confirmed by this model.
Inverter availability, clipping, grid outage, curtailment or meter alignment may also explain part of the shortfall.
A gradual equipment or metering degradation could produce a persistent weather-adjusted deviation.
These are possible explanations only. Isolation Forest scores are not probabilities or fault diagnoses.
checks: Review inverter event logs and MPPT/string status.
Compare main-meter and independent generation readings for the same intervals.
Check cleaning, shading and maintenance records around the period.
Confirm grid outage or curtailment history.
Request a qualified inspection only if the deviation persists after data-quality checks.
